claim.claim-text: 2. The stock picking system according to claim 1, wherein the two picking passages (121) are arranged side by side or in parallel, and the two picking points (122) are respectively located at bottoms of the U shapes of the two picking passages (121), and a picking work zone (11) for a picking operator to move is formed at an end of the two picking passages (121) away from the stock container zone (20).

3. The stock picking system according to claim 2, wherein the two picking passages (121) are arranged adjacent to each other; and preferably, wherein the two picking points (122) are arranged adjacent to each other.

4. The stock picking system according to claim 3, wherein the picking work zone (11) is provided with two put walls (112) opposite to each other, each put wall (112) accommodating a plurality of order containers, and the two picking points (122) are located in an extension space formed by the two put walls (112).

5. The stock picking system according to claim 1, wherein the two picking passages (121) in each picking station (1) are spaced apart from each other; the two picking points (122) are respectively located on lateral sides of the U shapes of the two picking passages (121) and are arranged oppositely, and a picking work zone (11) for a picking operator to move is formed between the two picking passages (121); and preferably, wherein a picking face (2021) of the stock container (202) located in the picking zone (10) is parallel to lateral sides of the U shape of each picking passage (121).

6. The stock picking system according to any one of claims 2 to 5, wherein one picking passage (121) of the two picking passages (121) provides a traveling route in a clockwise direction, and the other picking passage (121)) provides a traveling route in a counterclockwise direction.

7. The stock picking system according to any one of claims 3 or 4, wherein each picking passage (121) has an entrance grid (1231) forming an entrance of the picking passage (121) and an exit grid (1232) forming an exit of the picking passage (121), and a traveling width of the entrance grid (1231) and the exit grid (1232) is larger than a maximum outer diameter of the stock container (202).

8. The stock picking system according to any one of claims 3 to 5, wherein each picking passage (121) comprises an entrance passage (1211) and an exit passage (1212) forming two lateral sides of the U shape; the exit passage (1212) is located on a side of the picking passage (121) adjacent to another picking station (1); and the adjacent two picking stations (1) share one exit passage (1212).

9. The stock picking system according to claim 1, wherein the stock container zone (20) and the picking zone (10) are logically provided with two-dimensional grids, and one two-dimensional grid in the picking zones (10) corresponds to one of the picking points (122).

10. The stock picking system according to claim 9, wherein in each picking passage (121), the two-dimensional grids located upstream of the picking point (122) on the picking passage (121) form an area for the transfer robot (40) to pass and wait.
11. The stock picking system according to claim 9, wherein a reference mark is provided at a center of at least one of the two-dimensional grids for positioning by the transfer robot (40).

12. The stock picking system according to claim 1, wherein a layout mode of picking station (1) comprises one of: a dual-station symmetrical layout mode, a parallel layout mode, or a mode of queuing with no specific rotation zone.

13. The stock picking system according to claim 12, wherein in a case where the layout mode of the picking station (1) comprises the dual-station symmetrical layout mode, the picking station (1) comprises two rotation zones, the two picking passages (121) being around the two rotation zones respectively, the two picking passages (121) being partially overlapped to form a passage area between the two rotation zones, each picking passage (121) being provided with an entrance position, an operation position, a plurality of rotation zone entry positions, a plurality of queuing return positions, and an exit position, wherein the operation position is a position where the transfer robot (40) transporting the stock containers (202) waits for the picking operator's operation; the rotation zone entry position is a position allowing the transfer robot (40) to enter the rotation zone from the picking passage (121); the queuing return position is a position allowing the transfer robot (40) to enter the picking passage (121) from the rotation zone; the entrance position is set in the passage area, the two picking passages (121) sharing one entrance position; and the rotation zone entry positions, the queuing return positions and the exit positions on the two picking passages (121) are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the passage area; or

in a case where the layout mode of the picking station (1) comprises the parallel layout mode, the picking station (1) comprises two rotation zones, the two picking passages (121) being around the two rotation zones respectively, each picking passage (121) being provided with an entrance position, an operation position, a plurality of rotation zone entry positions, a plurality of queuing return positions, and an exit position, the two picking passages (121) being arranged in parallel, wherein the operation position is a position where the transfer robot (40) transporting the stock container (202) waits for the picking operator's operation; the rotation zone entry position is a position allowing the transfer robot (40) to enter the rotation zone from the picking passage (121); and the queuing return position is a position allowing the transfer robot (40) to enter the picking passage (121) from the rotation zone; or in a case where the layout mode of the picking station (1) comprises a mode of queuing with no specific rotation zone, each picking passage (121) is used as a rotation zone, the picking passage (121) being provided with an operation position, an exit position, and a plurality of entrance positions, the plurality of entrance positions being located between the operation position and the exit position.

14. The stock picking system according to claim 1, further comprising: a shelf management apparatus configured to perform real-time detection on a surrounding environment where the stock container is located within a traveling route from allocation to completion of a transport task, and control the transfer robot (40) to perform a rotation operation on the stock container in response to detecting that the surrounding environment is suitable for rotation.

15. The stock picking system according to claim 14, wherein the shelf management apparatus is further configured to: control the transfer robot (40) to perform the rotation operation in a transporting route, at a rotation point set in the picking station, or in situ at an operation position; and preferably, the shelf management apparatus is further configured to:
